title: Q-RES-perez-lopez-1974-P1: A control system that only corrects deviations from plans (measured 0.4, target >= 0.9)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: perez-lopez-1974 finding P1 is not-met (measured 0.4)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe perez-lopez-1974:P1
**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe perez-lopez-1974:P1`
**Status:** closed

Concern: A control system that only corrects deviations from plans. The study: In a stable system feedback only corrects deviations from a plan that someone outside set. In an ultrastable system the aim of the control function is twofold: "Ensure that plans are consistent with objectives" and "Ensure that plans are accomplished". A system whose work items carry no objective to be measured against can only do the second.

Mechanisms that should answer it: GOALS-1 (seed/worker/src/goals.js); PLAN-1 (seed/worker/src/planner.js); SPEC-GATE-1 (seed/scripts/specgate.py).

Metric: share of open work items with a done check, a prediction, an out-of-scope line and a live proof (foundation/specgate.py), target >= 0.9. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (2 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): perez-lopez-1974:P1: spec_quality = 1.0 target >= 0.9 (met)
